claims.wording: Quitty advertises a macOS maintenance, monitoring and storage-management utility.
claims.excerpt: Quitty is an all-in-one macOS utility for system maintenance, performance optimization, and storage management.

claims.wording: The homepage describes Quitty as free and open-source.
claims.excerpt: Free, open-source, and built to make your macOS experience better.
claims.conditions: No amount, paid edition, subscription, region or tax conditions documented; specific license remains unverified. Does not prove a working free download.

claims.wording: The documented source-build prerequisites are Xcode 14+ and macOS 14.6+.
claims.excerpt: To build Quitty yourself, you'll need Xcode 14+ and macOS 14.6+.
claims.conditions: Build prerequisites only, not verified binary minimum OS or architecture support.

claims.wording: Quitty's vendor warns that its app lacks a paid Apple Developer certificate and may be blocked by Gatekeeper.
claims.excerpt: Because Quitty hasn't been signed with a $99/yr paid Apple Developer certificate, macOS Gatekeeper might block it from running the first time.
claims.conditions: $99/year describes the vendor's certificate explanation, not Quitty's price. Binary signing/notarization not inspected; do not copy or execute quarantine-removal advice.

claims.wording: Quitty advertises live CPU, RAM, disk and battery dashboard statistics.
claims.excerpt: Live CPU, RAM, disk, and battery statistics with visual charts and graphs for system metrics.
claims.conditions: Not benchmarked; collection intervals and helper grouping unknown.

claims.wording: Quitty advertises temporary-file/cache/log cleaning and a Trash manager.
claims.excerpt: Removes temporary files, caches, logs, and system junk. Trash manager across all volumes and user accounts
claims.conditions: Permission coverage, review controls and exact deletion methods unverified; omit vendor safe-to-delete guarantee.

claims.wording: Quitty advertises duplicate finding, a large-files scanner and an interactive disk-space map.
claims.excerpt: Duplicate file finder with full-system scan support, large files scanner with detailed size analysis, and visual disk space map with interactive directory browsing.
claims.conditions: Advertised scope only; full-disk completeness and duplicate accuracy not tested.

claims.wording: Quitty describes a RAM booster that terminates processes, per-process CPU monitoring and a startup manager.
claims.excerpt: RAM booster to free memory by terminating unnecessary processes, real-time CPU monitoring with per-process breakdown, and startup manager to control login items.
claims.conditions: Not a recommendation to terminate processes or a measured speedup; graceful/forced behavior and necessity criteria unknown.

claims.wording: Quitty advertises per-application network usage and connection analysis.
claims.excerpt: Real-time upload and download speed tracking with per-application bandwidth usage and active connection analysis.
claims.conditions: No implementation or accuracy test; do not claim Breathing Room has equivalent network monitoring.

claims.wording: Quitty advertises daily, weekly and monthly cleaning/optimization scheduling plus idle-time scheduling.
claims.excerpt: Task scheduler for cleaning and optimization routines with daily, weekly, and monthly recurrence options. Idle-time scheduling to minimize disruption.
claims.conditions: Runtime, approval, account and wake behavior unknown; no scheduling test.

claims.wording: Quitty advertises an app uninstaller with leftover detection, a process manager and system information.
claims.excerpt: Full app uninstaller with leftover file detection, process manager for viewing and controlling running processes, and detailed hardware and software system information.
claims.conditions: Advertised breadth, not validated completeness or parity.

workflow.title: Inspect a busy Mac app before using a RAM booster
workflow.primaryIntent: Distinguish inspecting an app and its helper processes from terminating processes to lower a RAM number.
workflow.distinctMechanism: Quitty's documented process-terminating RAM-booster pitch (Q09) versus grouped app/helper inspection (BR01); not another generic Mac cleanup list.
outline: Start with the inspection-versus-termination decision, without a performance promise
Show labeled Breathing Room Apps example after the lead
Read app and helper totals with shared-memory/sample limitations
Explain Quitty's documented process-termination mechanism as vendor wording, not a tested recommendation
Choose based on the task, not an automatically smaller RAM figure
workflow.interactionPass: Hand off a no-action decision checklist: identify the app, review helpers, save work, distinguish graceful quit from force termination, and do not infer a fault from a single sample. No process controls or filesystem access in a widget.
requiredAdditionalEvidence: Official Apple source on memory pressure/shared-memory interpretation before adding general macOS advice
Working official release/repository and binary requirements
Cleared, visually reviewed competitor app image
workflow.disclosure: Breathing Room, which we build; this is source/document research, not a hands-on Quitty test.
